title: John Wheeler's U diagram of the self-observing universe

tellings.quote: the the U with an where one tip of U is the big bang and the other tip is an eyeball staring back at the big bang

plain: The physicist John Wheeler drew the universe as a letter U: one tip is the Big Bang, and the other tip is an eyeball staring back at the Big Bang, so the universe looks back at its own beginning. The writer Eric Wargo describes the drawing in his own summary, linking it to the physicists Yakir Aharonov and John Cramer. The idea he draws from it is that observers now might help shape the universe's past.
